children: ”), a leader in Canadian lithium development, is pleased to announce, further to its announcement on September 24, 2026, that an aggregate of 12,782,250 common share purchase warrants (“
”) are expected to commence trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on October 2, 2026 under the symbol ETL.WT.A.

The Warrants were issued pursuant to the Company’s public offering of units that closed on September 24, 2026. Each Warrant entitles the holder thereof to acquire one common share of the Company at a price of $1.10 until September 24, 2029.

The ISIN and CUSIP numbers of the Warrants are CA26925V1408 and 26925V140, respectively. The Warrants are governed by the terms of the warrant indenture dated September 17, 2026, between the Company and Odyssey Trust Company as warrant agent (the “
”). A copy of the Warrant Indenture is available under the Company’s profile on www.sedarplus.ca.
ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS

E3 Lithium is a development company with a total of 21.2 million tonnes (Mt) of lithium carbonate equivalent (LCE) Measured and Indicated mineral resources as well as 0.3 Mt LCE Inferred mineral resources in Alberta, comprised of (a) Measured and Indicated mineral resources of 16.2 Mt LCE at a lithium grade of 75.5 mg/L within its Clearwater Project1 and (b) Measured and Indicated mineral resources of 5.0 Mt LCE at a lithium grade of 54.0 mg/L and Inferred mineral resources of 0.3 Mt LCE at a lithium grade of 42 mg/L within its Garrington District2. The Clearwater Pre-Feasibility Study outlined a 1.13 Mt LCE proven and probable mineral reserve at a lithium grade of 75.5 mg/L, with a pre-tax NPV(8%) of USD 5.2 Billion with a 29.2% IRR and an after-tax NPV(8%) of USD 3.7 Billion with a 24.6% IRR1.

1: The technical report titled “Clearwater Project, NI 43-101 Technical Report on Pre-Feasibility Study, Bashaw District Mineral Property, Central Alberta, Canada”, with an effective date of June 20, 2024, is available on E3 Lithium’s website (www.e3lithium.ca/technical-reports/) and under E3 Lithium’s profile on SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca).

2: The technical report titled “NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Garrington District Lithium Resource Estimate”, with effective date of June 25, 2025, is available on E3 Lithium’s website (www.e3lithium.ca/technical-reports/) and under E3 Lithium’s profile on SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca).
